summary: Iteration 55 - All backend features tested and working. Backend: 18/18 tests passed (100%). New features verified: Document Type Testing Tool API, Map Export (4 formats), PayPal Wallet Accumulation, Personal Reports CRUD, Gamification badges. Frontend Admin Panel Doc Types tab accessible with InfoJet 2.0 Document Classification settings.
critical_code_review_comments: DoctypeTestingTool.js - New Admin UI component for testing document classification with sample text, properly uses data-testid='doctype-testing-tool'
PersonalReportCreator.js - New UI component for creating Personal Reports (Organic) with title, content, topic, location, and image upload
admin.py - New endpoints: POST /api/admin/doctype-test for document classification testing, GET /api/admin/paypal-wallets for wallet accumulation
server.py - Map export endpoints support 4 formats: JSON, GeoJSON, KML, CSV with proper data structure
gamification_service.py - New badges added: first_personal_report (Storyteller), phd_finder (Academic Hunter), news_junkie (News Junkie)
updated_files: /app/tests/test_iteration55_features.py - Created comprehensive test suite for iteration 55 features

success_rate.frontend: 100% - Admin Panel Doc Types tab accessible

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 55 features verified: 1) POST /api/admin/doctype-test - Document classification testing with sample text returns classification, analysis, and protocol_matches, 2) Map Export - GET /api/map-data/export supports format=json|geojson|kml|csv, 3) GET /api/map-data/statistics returns regions and export_formats, 4) GET /api/admin/paypal-wallets returns wallet balances and payout info, 5) Personal Reports CRUD working via /api/personal-reports, 6) Gamification badges include new content-related badges (storyteller, academic_hunter, news_junkie)
